The application is twoPhaseEulerFoam, as set in system/controlDict.
The domain is 10 m in x, 5 m in y, and 1 m in z (one cell), with the frontAndBack patch set to empty in the decomposeParDict or blockMeshDict to enforce 2D behaviour.
The mesh consists of 200 cells in x, 100 cells in y, and 1 cell in z.
All four side walls (left, right, bottom, top) are solid no-slip boundaries with U fixed to (0, 0, 0) and alpha.water fixed to 0.
The frontAndBack faces are empty patches.
The water column is initialised using setFields with a box from (0, 0, 0) to (5, 5, 1), setting alpha.water = 1 inside the box and alpha.water = 0 everywhere else in the domain.
The initial velocity field U is zero everywhere.
The simulation end time is 2 s.
The domain is fully closed; no boundary allows outflow or inflow.
